facts.statement: The changed source defines MD_FLAG_SPOILERS as 0x10000 and describes ||hidden text|| as a spoiler span recognized when that flag is enabled.
With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS set, the parser scans pipe characters and collects each double pipe on a line as one potential opener or closer.

evidence.dependency_reason: The flag makes pipes eligible for mark scanning.

facts.statement: For paired collected double pipes, spoiler analysis resolves the opener and closer; inline processing then issues MD_SPAN_SPOILER enter and leave callbacks.

evidence.dependency_reason: The pipe analyzer pairs the delimiters.
The spoiler flag selects pipe analysis for double-pipe marks.

facts.statement: The supplied closing HTML callback emits </x-spoiler> for MD_SPAN_SPOILER when image nesting does not suppress span output. The opening HTML callback is not established by the supplied evidence.

The fixed harness reads two native unsigned words from sufficiently long fuzz input, uses the first as parser flags, and passes all remaining bytes to md_html. A finite input can therefore supply parser flags containing 0x10000, renderer flags zero, and Markdown ||text||.

evidence.dependency_reason: Identifies the spoiler flag value selected by the first input word.

facts.statement: md_html forwards the harness's parser flags and Markdown bytes to md_parse with span callbacks. The parser processes ordinary block contents through inline analysis and inline rendering, providing a caller path to the spoiler code.

evidence.dependency_reason: Constructs the parser with the supplied flags and HTML span callbacks.
Forwards the Markdown input to md_parse.
Block processing invokes leaf block processing.
Ordinary leaf blocks invoke normal block contents processing.

facts.statement: The existing input-controlled parser flag and Markdown bytes provide a route to the spoiler span callbacks; the harness need not name MD_FLAG_SPOILERS in its source.

evidence.dependency_reason: The input-selected flag enables collection of the delimiter bytes.
The same flag selects spoiler delimiter resolution.
Resolved delimiters dispatch spoiler span callbacks.

facts.statement: The supplied recipe compiles this fuzz entry and links it with the HTML renderer and parser static libraries; these lines specify the recipe but do not establish a successful build.
The harness's output callback discards rendered bytes, but the entry still passes that callback to md_html; discarding output does not remove the parser's route to spoiler span callbacks.

evidence.dependency_reason: The entry supplies the callback while invoking md_html.
md_html installs the output callback and its HTML span callbacks in the renderer and parser.

facts.statement: The complete fixed harness checks minimum input length but contains no assertion about output bytes or md_html's return value.

missing_information: To establish the opening x-spoiler tag, supply the after-source body of src/md4c-html.c::enter_span_callback, including its MD_SPAN_SPOILER case.
